indicator: Social economy share of paid employment
numerator: Annual average paid employee jobs in active entities meeting the pilot SSE definition
denominator: Annual average paid employee jobs across the same domestic economy and year
proposed_calculation: 100 × numerator / denominator; same job-based unit and coverage in both terms
data_gap: No validated comprehensive numerator; reconcile employee jobs versus resident persons before choosing a denominator
next_action: Establish entity perimeter and obtain matching aggregate employment counts

numerator: Eligible social enterprises born in year t and economically active in year t+3
denominator: All eligible social enterprises born in year t in the observed birth cohort
proposed_calculation: 100 × numerator / denominator; administrative registration alone does not prove activity
data_gap: No validated longitudinal cohort with stable identifiers; entity identity and social-enterprise status must be followed
next_action: Define births and activity; document mergers, closures, missing follow-up and changes in eligibility

indicator: Six-month paid employment retention among target-group entrants
numerator: Target-group entrants still in paid employment at an eligible entity six months after entry
denominator: All target-group paid employment entrants in the same entry cohort with a full six-month observation window
proposed_calculation: 100 × numerator / denominator; report separately for each predefined target group; unknown follow-up remains unknown
data_gap: Requires cohort follow-up and approved aggregate disaggregation; membership or beneficiary counts are not employment
next_action: Define target groups and follow-up protocol; report missing follow-up and response coverage

numerator: Paid workers reporting access to and use of a defined participatory decision mechanism during the reference year
denominator: Paid workers with valid responses to the same question in the pilot survey
proposed_calculation: Weighted survey proportion only with a defensible sampling design; otherwise label as respondent-only descriptive results
data_gap: No validated survey instrument or representative sampling frame
next_action: Pilot the question with workers; publish response rate, item non-response and sampling limitations
